AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#673 @ df76889fb862095170498dccb23f35db3d116690 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/1/2

Reviewer: agent 118, job AUD-SOL-T23-118; independent first full T4 audit of this 11-file / 2,627-line T3 piece, including original #656 history, all restacks, the round-8 trial-end writer, checkout/billing call sites, transaction/post-commit boundaries, conflict retry/alert worker and every piece test. [Candidate and round 8](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5977778572)

### Prior findings first

**Original B-656-1 closes at its reported ephemeral-obligation boundary:** a lost one-trial race durably owes cancellation in the webhook transaction, process loss/transient failure leaves replayable work, and later trialing/$0-invoice events retain the access veto; the candidate lifecycle controls pass, but destructive retries after an already-paid conversion expose the additional boundary below. [Original finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/656#issuecomment-5965268813) [Current candidate controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218265800)

**B-656-6 closes at its reported shared-alert-receipt boundary:** `billed_alerted_at` is separate from `alerted_at`, and a failed-cancellation alert followed by a processed active conversion still emits the billed alert once, including concurrent alert-sweep controls. [Original finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/656#issuecomment-5972091723) [Worker receipts](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/df76889fb862095170498dccb23f35db3d116690/src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts#L282-L314) [Executed controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218265800)

**B-656-7 closes for T3's direct worker/handler diagnostic changes:** closed classifications remain in the cancellation, alert and settle-lookup paths, and candidate canaries pass; unrelated historical logging is not claimed fixed here. [Current direct diagnostics](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/df76889fb862095170498dccb23f35db3d116690/src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts) [Executed canaries](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218265800)

The round-8 C-671-4 writer change preserves `trial_ends_at=null` for never-started attempts and retains started-trial history through cancellation; verified builder before **1 failed / 68 passed**, after **286/286** plus type-check, and current real-handler controls pass. [Writer change and boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5977778572) [Before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37185687036) [After](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37185762015) [Independent controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218265800)

No approved-code evidence is reused: original #656 had no Sol APPROVE and this piece had no previous Sol verdict; the full current T3 diff was read rather than treating its restack label as inherited approval. [Original Sol verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/656#issuecomment-5972091723) [Piece history](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673)

### B-673-1 — an owed retry blindly cancels an already-paid plan when the active webhook is delayed/missing

**File:line:** `src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts:164–225,265–287`; the retry consults only local `status='owed'` and sends `cancelSubscription()` without reconciling Stripe's current billing/subscription state, then writes `cancelled`; the only paid-plan supersession path is triggered by a processed `status='active'` webhook in `checkout-webhook-handler.service.ts:959–976`. [Destructive retry](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/df76889fb862095170498dccb23f35db3d116690/src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts#L164-L225) [Sweep and alert admission](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/df76889fb862095170498dccb23f35db3d116690/src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts#L265-L287) [Webhook-only supersession](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/df76889fb862095170498dccb23f35db3d116690/src/checkout/checkout-webhook-handler.service.ts#L959-L976)

**Executed counterexample:** after three cancellation failures spanning the trial end, the local row remains owed while the modeled Stripe subscription is now paid/active and its active webhook has not arrived; the **real TrialConflictService and real StripeConnectApiService**, over an intercepted synthetic fetch, issue **only `DELETE /subscriptions/sub-paid`**, no canonical-state read, and settle the conflict as cancelled. [Exact-source paid-retry failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218424769)

This bypasses the piece's explicit paid-plan policy: an already-billed client is meant to retain the regular paid plan and generate the separate refund/support alert, whereas `cancelled` is excluded from that billed-alert sweep and the subsequent subscription-deleted handler revokes access. [Intended policy and alert selection](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/df76889fb862095170498dccb23f35db3d116690/src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts#L30-L40) [Actual billed-alert selection](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/df76889fb862095170498dccb23f35db3d116690/src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts#L282-L287) [Deletion entitlement transition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/df76889fb862095170498dccb23f35db3d116690/src/checkout/checkout-webhook-handler.service.ts#L1091-L1135)

**Minimal fix rule:** an owed row is not proof that the remote subscription is still a free trial; reconcile authoritative current billing/subscription state before destructive retry, fail closed on unknown state, and durably supersede/arm the billed alert instead of cancelling an already-paid conversion. Fence the state transition/admission so webhook supersession or terminal changes cannot be undone by a stale worker.

**Verification:** retain the paid-active/missed-webhook counterexample; cover trial-end crossing during preparation, active-event-before/after retry, unknown canonical reads, cancellation/deletion, and the unchanged “still trialing -> cancel once” and failure-alert -> billed-alert controls.

### C-673-1 — integrated recurring/trials candidate qualification retained

`src/checkout/checkout.module.ts:49–83` and the trial webhook seam still require the C-656-1/#680 integration list: shared trial schema, one reservation/release authority, capability registration, typed trial parameters and unified webhook state, plus mobile #338 and the configured trial-ending event before deploy. [Integration list and landing contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5977778572) [Module seam](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/df76889fb862095170498dccb23f35db3d116690/src/checkout/checkout.module.ts#L49-L83)

That is not a second standalone T3 blocker or approval of real native checkout; T2's separately reported B-672-3 belongs to its owner and is not double-counted against this piece. [T2 exact-head verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5982319373)

### C-673-2 — a late sweep row gets an already-expired cancellation lease

**File:line:** `trial-conflict.service.ts:164–181,220,265–272`; the sweep's single old `now` supplies every serial lease/backoff timestamp, unlike the fresh-clock notice worker. [Lease/backoff](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/df76889fb862095170498dccb23f35db3d116690/src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts#L164-L220) [Sweep clock](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/df76889fb862095170498dccb23f35db3d116690/src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts#L265-L272)

**Executed counterexample:** seven prior nine-second cancels (below the real API's ten-second and worker's twenty-second bounds) make the eighth operation start at +63 seconds with a lease ending at +60; a fresh replica five seconds later issues a **second cancellation**, returning `cancelled` instead of `busy`. [Initial execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218265800) [Independent refinement](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218424769)

The duplicate DELETE alone has not demonstrated a double charge or incorrect final row, because completion fencing remains effective, so it is nonblocking rather than promoted by label; use fresh per-claim/admission/backoff clocks and retain this probe when editing the same B-673-1 admission lines. [Executed result](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218424769)

### Evidence and CI boundaries

The first test-only child `8fe53f9e418eca8b2f06058b6e065417509e79fa`, directly based on this head, executes **3 deliberate failures / 133 passing controls** across eight targeted suites; two failures belong to T2 and one is C-673-2, with all candidate trial/HTTP/alert controls passing. [First one-job run](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218265800)

Refined test child `67469107c9f77cef1c845fe80a7d5fd7e3304a3c` preserves every candidate source/schema/dependency input, and workflow receipt `5ccf372a511988309bbabfbf925af17472ddece5` executes **two behavioral failures**—B-673-1 and C-673-2—with no fixture/type failure counted as defect evidence. [Paid-retry refinement](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218424769)

Applicable stacked candidate checks are green; main-only CodeQL/danger/banned-casts/SBOM remain landing gates, and deploy-readiness skips by policy; this **2,627-line** piece stays below the hard cap. [Candidate CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37186105856) [Size/check contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5977778572)

Outside-diff never-billed-trial MRR/churn observations are routed only in the operator report, not made blockers on this piece; no candidate-branch edits, local heavy execution, merge, production action or real provider/customer operation. Notes/probes/logs and handoff: `ops/aud-118/AUD-SOL-T23-118/`, `ops/reports/AUD-SOL-T23-118.md`.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#673 @ 5fdb5f5cf6fb09a23dd56382a47aafa4d0089c5d — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/2/1

Reviewer: AUD-SOL-T23-119, agent 119. Independent T4 review of T3 checkout/billing/webhook/module boundaries, full conflict worker, purchase view, tests and round-9 delta; no approved-code evidence reused because this lens never approved original #656 or a preceding T3 head. [Prior Sol](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5982336690), [Original Sol](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/656#issuecomment-5972091723).

### Prior findings first

The exact **B-673-1 active/paid-with-missing-webhook input now passes**: actual TrialConflictService + actual StripeConnectApiService over intercepted fetch issues GET without DELETE and durably supersedes the conflict; the finding remains narrowly open for the paid-history inputs below. [Round 9](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5982762294), [Independent replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228826610).

**Sol C-673-2 closes:** the retained eight-row/seven-nine-second cancellation probe now obtains a fresh lease and the replica returns busy; the sole adaptation is adding a `retrieveSubscription` stub returning a still-trialing subscription, preserving the original timing and assertions. [Independent replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228826610).

Original B-656-1/6/7 stay closed at their previously reported durable-obligation, separate billed-alert receipt and direct-worker diagnostic boundaries, and C-671-4 remains closed at the writer; current candidate controls pass. [Prior dispositions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5982336690), [Executed controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228826610).

Builder failing-before reports 12 behavioral failures / 40 passing controls, and passing-after reports 183/183; those tests confirm the stated fixes but do not cover the two cancellation-admission boundaries below. [Before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37221109080), [After](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37221153162).

### B-673-1 — narrowed: present past_due/unpaid status is not proof that the conflict never billed

**File:line:** `src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts:63–91,230–247,346–351`: `UNBILLED_STATUSES` treats `past_due`/`unpaid` as safe to cancel, although the subscription read contains no complete historical paid-invoice evidence. [Decision](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/5fdb5f5cf6fb09a23dd56382a47aafa4d0089c5d/src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts#L63-L91), [Dispatch](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/5fdb5f5cf6fb09a23dd56382a47aafa4d0089c5d/src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts#L230-L247).

**Executed counterexample:** durable owed conflict survives an outage, first regular invoice is paid, active events are delayed/missing, and a later renewal is now past_due or unpaid; actual worker/API over intercepted fetch issues **GET then DELETE** in both modeled states and records cancellation instead of preserving the paid-plan/refund-alert recovery path. [Two behavioral failures](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228826610).

Stripe defines past_due by failed/unattempted payment of the applicable invoice and unpaid by unsettled invoices governing current status—not by absence of previous paid invoices; a missing active observation therefore cannot establish never-billed history. [Stripe subscription status documentation](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/overview).

The builder's policy note acknowledges this all-active-observations-missed case, which is within the prior finding's delayed/missing-event and outage boundary, not a new refund-policy request. [Round-9 policy note](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5982762294).

**Minimal fix rule:** preserve already-billed conversion and its billed alert; fail closed on ambiguous paid history instead of inferring never-billed from present status. Authoritative billing evidence must establish the safe destructive action; any lists used for that decision must be complete and bounded.

**Verification:** retain paid-active and both paid-history status probes; cover never-billed first-payment failure as a separate control, prior positive payment evidence, unknown/incomplete evidence, terminal states and alert deduplication.

### B-673-2 — new: committed webhook supersession during GET does not veto an obsolete DELETE

**File:line:** `trial-conflict.service.ts:230–240,259–278`: the worker checks owed status only before claiming; after the awaited remote read it dispatches DELETE without checking current owed status/token, and fences only the final local outcome. [Read/dispatch](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/5fdb5f5cf6fb09a23dd56382a47aafa4d0089c5d/src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts#L205-L240), [Too-late outcome fence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/5fdb5f5cf6fb09a23dd56382a47aafa4d0089c5d/src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts#L259-L278).

**Executed actual-handler counterexample:** Stripe GET captured trialing with a future end; an early paid conversion's active webhook commits supersession and grants access before that response arrives; the older response still admits DELETE, its subscription-deleted webhook removes the newly granted access, and the worker returns **stale** while the conflict row remains **superseded**. [Actual CheckoutWebhookHandlerService + actual Stripe API over intercepted fetch](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228997327).

The refined probe observes **GET, DELETE; paidAccess=false** instead of GET-only with access retained; this proves external damage despite the apparently correct final row fence, not merely a duplicate idempotent cancel. [Behavioral result](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228997327).

Stripe supports ending a trial immediately with `trial_end=now`; the date-distance guard does not protect a stale response from such early conversion, and the candidate already explicitly tests early paid conversion and webhook supersession. [Stripe trial API](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions/update), [Candidate round-9 tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/5fdb5f5cf6fb09a23dd56382a47aafa4d0089c5d/test/b-trials-3-fix-round.spec.ts#L1203-L1217).

**Minimal fix rule:** after remote preparation and before destructive dispatch, revalidate that the conflict remains owed and this worker still owns its current lease; committed supersession, terminal state or ownership loss must veto the DELETE. Keep completion fencing and fresh deadline admission; do not hold a DB transaction across provider HTTP.

**Verification:** retain actual-handler race and existing near-trial-end control; add supersession/terminal/ownership changes during GET with an end still far away, alongside unchanged still-trialing cancellation and paid-active preservation.

### C-673-1 — integrated recurring/trials qualification retained

`src/checkout/checkout.module.ts:49–83` and the trial webhook seam still require the #680 composition list, unified trial schema/reservation/release/capability/entitlement authority, never-billed-trial MRR/churn exclusion, mobile #338 pairing and configured trial-ending event; the T2 customer-card B belongs to #672 and is not double-counted here. [Existing qualification](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5982762294), [Prior Sol gate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5982336690).

### Evidence / size / CI

First test-only child `817b92b8` directly based on this head reports **4 deliberate failures / 142 passing controls** across eight suites; three failures concern T3, one concerns T2; refinement `ca2e8a56` adds only tests and reports **4 behavioral failures / 3 passing controls**, including the actual-handler paid-access race and retained prior probes. [First run](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228826610), [Refinement](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228997327).

Receipts `0f3f082d883baaab723e4d9e333c557cf1191d47` and `7d00c5ca091de413ba2f2939127e3eb6100d73ef` add only CI-lane files; candidate source/schema/dependencies remain unchanged, and no compilation/fixture error is counted as a defect. [First execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228826610), [Refined execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228997327).

Applicable exact-head stacked checks pass; deploy-readiness is skipped and main-only CodeQL/danger/banned-casts/SBOM remain landing gates; size **2,887** leaves **113** lines under the hard cap and the operator already posted KEEP. [Candidate CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37221526092), [SIZE ASSESSMENT](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5982776246).

Other-lens optional follow-ups remain report/ticket items. No candidate-source edits, heavy local execution, real provider/customer action, merge or production action.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#673 @ 904b964250f4b7694b24f78fdef5a5f846957013 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/1/2

Agent 119 · AUD-SOL-T23D-119 · independent T4 delta audit.

**Prior findings decided first.** B-673-2 CLOSED for its committed-supersession-before-DELETE example: the owed-status/lease-token recheck after remote reads now vetoes supersession, deletion and lease takeover, and the retained actual-handler test keeps paid access with GET only. [Independent replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234895866).
B-673-1's original already-paid-history examples close: past_due/unpaid with positive paid evidence supersede, incomplete/missing history defers, and active status remains protected; however the same paid-plan-preservation obligation remains narrowly open at concurrent first payment below. [Candidate 23/23 regression replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234703167), [Independent boundary challenge](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234895866).
Sol C-673-2 fresh clock remains closed, with its previously adapted fixture replayed unchanged. [Independent retained clock proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234895866).

### B-673-1 — narrowed: paid-history preparation does not fence a concurrent first payment

**Where:** `src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts:265-286`, paid-list result → local ownership check → DELETE; the missing remote payment-settlement guard is inside the changed admission path. [Exact-head admission](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/904b964250f4b7694b24f78fdef5a5f846957013/src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts#L261-L286).

**Concrete counterexample:** an owed conflict survives into past_due/unpaid with its first regular invoice still open; the worker's paid list is captured with only the zero-value trial invoice and `has_more:false`, then the first regular payment succeeds before that response arrives while its active webhook is delayed, so the local row remains owed under the same lease. The worker DELETEs the now-paid plan. [Two independently executed counterexamples](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234895866).
This is a pre-admission remote commit, not a post-dispatch state change: the payment already succeeded during the paid-invoice GET, before the new local `findFirst` and DELETE decision. [Executed ordering](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234895866).
Actual TrialConflictService + actual StripeConnectApiService + actual CheckoutWebhookHandlerService over intercepted synthetic transport produce, for BOTH statuses: `paidCents=4900`, `deletes=1`, delayed active handler access `true`, subsequent deleted handler access `false`, worker outcome `stale`, conflict row `superseded`; all fixture/impact controls pass before the intended no-DELETE assertion fails. [Explicit payment/access receipts](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234895866).
Paying the relevant outstanding invoice can reactivate a past_due/unpaid plan, and canceling disables automatic collection but is not an invoice-void acknowledgment. [Stripe subscription status documentation](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/overview?locale=en-GB), [Stripe cancellation documentation](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/cancel).

**Minimal fix rule:** before deleting a never-billed past_due/unpaid subscription, make each applicable collectible open invoice non-payable through an authoritative bounded/replay-safe settlement (for example, confirmed void); if payment wins, an invoice is paid/not-open, or evidence is unknown, preserve the plan and supersede or retry rather than DELETE. Re-check local ownership after that preparation and preserve complete-list, lease-budget, billed-alert and never-billed controls; merely adding another unlocked GET does not close the payment race. [Failing admission proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234895866).
Verify with these exact two first-payment races failing before/passing after, paid-vs-void races, unknown/partial invoice settlement, takeover/supersession during every added await, and a truly never-billed control that voids then cancels once. [Retained counterexample bundle](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234895866).
This overlaps Opus C-673-6, but the demonstrated consequence is actual paid-access removal, so it is a must-fix B under G11 rather than an optional #680 follow-up; Opus's approval was not borrowed. [Separate Opus finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5984213420), [Independent money-loss proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234895866).

### Follow-ups (C)

- **C-673-1 — retained integration qualification (outside this delta):** `src/checkout/checkout.module.ts:49-83`; qualify #680/full trials composition with unified reservation/release and webhook state, capability and typed trial parameters, mobile #338 and configured trial-ending event before deploy. Worker-only supersede entitlement resync remains on the established #680 integration round, not silently fixed here. [Prior Sol qualification](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5983683888), [Existing C-673-4 placement](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5984069501).
- **C-673-7 — malformed-money hardening:** `trial-conflict.service.ts:88-93`; zero `amount_paid` with missing `total`, negative amount and `NaN` all yield `none` instead of `unknown`, contrary to the complete/well-formed evidence claim. These are contract-hardening examples, not a claim that canonical Stripe emits invalid monetary fields. Minimal rule: require safe nonnegative integer monetary fields sufficient to exclude direct and credit-funded payment before `none`; unknown otherwise. [Three executed optional hardening failures](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234895866).

**G09 / boundary / CI:** No prior Sol APPROVE is reused; the entire round-10 delta was read against the prior reviewed REQUEST CHANGES head `5fdb5f5c`, prior proofs were replayed, and the T2 restack delta was verified byte-identical to #672's snapshot change. [Prior Sol verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5983683888), [Independent replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234895866).
Size 2,947 remains under the grandfathered 3,000 ceiling; 10 distinct ordinary applicable checks succeed, deploy-readiness is skipped, and main-only security/SBOM gates remain owed. [Exact-head checks](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673/checks).
Independent refinement: 90 controls pass / 5 intended behavior assertions fail (two B race cases, three C hardening cases), with no fixture/type failure; all seven prior Sol probes pass. [Completed targeted CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234895866).
No candidate source edits, heavy local runs or production actions occurred, and synthetic transport/database tests do not assert live Stripe/PostgreSQL acceptance. [Independent one-job CI evidence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234895866).
